title: Heteroresistance and satellite-colony research
text: Research has shown that resistant subpopulations can be unstable and difficult to detect. An inner colony or irregular zone should prompt expert review and suitable confirmatory investigation; an image flag alone does not prove heteroresistance. Population analysis profiling was used in the cited study. [S26]
